subject: Triage: Alex Mercer interview debrief and hiring consensus
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 Oct 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Triage: Alex Mercer interview debrief and hiring consensus

Hi team,

Thanks for taking the loop this morning. Alex came through four interviews (system design, model infra, coding, culture fit). I'm collecting scorecards and a short blurb from each of you to get to a hiring decision. Please do two quick things by EOD PST:

1) Fill the attached scorecard with numeric subscores (Technical, Design, Coding, Collaboration) and one-line recommendation (Strong Hire / Hire / Neutral / No Hire).
2) Reply with a 1-2 sentence rationale calling out any hard blockers or must-have follow-ups.

Attachments: alex-mercer-scorecard.xlsx (completed template), loop-feedback-annotated.pdf (my notes)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFGhIJKlmnOPqRs (candidate folder)
Greenhouse: https://greenhouse.io/candidate/12345

Quick summary from me: very strong product sense and communication. Some gaps on distributed KV design under load — flagged below as a risk but not necessarily blocker depending on role stretch. Recommend we get votes and decide whether to proceed to an offer.

Next step options I want to surface:
- Proceed to hiring committee / compensation prep (if consensus is Hire/Strong Hire)
- Another focused design follow-up (if technical risk needs closure)
- Pass (if major red flags)

If you can't open the attachment, let me know and I'll paste the template. Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes

Subject: Re: Triage: Alex Mercer interview debrief and hiring consensus

Rafael —

Filled the sheet and added a short note in the Drive. My quick take: Technical 4/5, System Design 3/5, Coding 4/5, Collaboration 5/5. Recommendation: Hire.

Rationale: Alex handled product tradeoffs well and communicates up and down; the distributed design questions exposed some unfamiliarity with our specific KV partitioning assumptions, but they demonstrated good learning agility. I don't see a blocker for a Senior ML Eng hire; we can mitigate with a short onboarding project and pairing.

Marissa

Rafael / Marissa —

Scorecard (attached): Technical 3/5, System Design 3/5, Coding 4/5, Collaboration 4/5. Recommendation: Neutral -> Lean Hire if we pair them with a senior infra owner during the first 6 weeks.

Notes:
- System design answers were pragmatic but surface-level for scale questions (consistent with a candidate coming from research-focused teams rather than ops-heavy infra).
- Coding exercise: clean and testable; commented code showed thoughtfulness.
- Culture: great collaborator, ask clarifying Qs, good ownership examples.

If we move forward I'd like a 30-minute follow-up with one of our infra SMEs to validate the partitioning/consistency assumptions.

- Marissa: Hire (Technical 4/5)
- Mina: Neutral -> Lean Hire (Technical 3/5)
- Jonas: Hire (+1)

Consensus: Proceed to offer / hiring committee with a recommended leveling at Senior ML Engineer. Action items:
- Marissa: open hiring committee note + suggested comp band (I can help draft).
- Mina: if you can spare 30 minutes, please do the infra follow-up (I can put it on Alex's calendar tomorrow afternoon PST).
- Jonas: will you +1 for the hiring committee note?

I'll hold off on candidate messaging until we have committee approval; Alex is currently marked as "in progress" in Greenhouse. Rafael will request comp once committee OKs.

I'll also attach the filled scorecard to the GH record after the committee.

Thanks — Rafael
